1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralPetalCones
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralSelection
3 
4 /-! The actual apex angles and widened base angles in an opposite-petal comparison. -/
5 
6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
7 
8 open Real EuclideanGeometry OctahedralTriangles
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
11 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
12   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
13 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
14 
15 noncomputable def petalApexAngle (i : Fin 4) : ℝ :=
16   angle (net.patch i).left (net.patch i).apex (net.patch i).right
17 
18 /-- The middle petal's left base angle, widened by the curvature at that original vertex. -/
19 noncomputable def widenedLeft (i : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
20   angle (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).apex +
21     graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.castSucc) + 1))
22 
23 noncomputable def widenedRight (i : Fin 2) : ℝ :=
24   angle (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).apex +
25     graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1))
26 
27 theorem petalApexAngle_eq (i : Fin 4) : net.petalApexAngle i = graph.fanAngle source (slit + i) := by
28   apply triangle_angle_of_distances
29   · simpa only [dist_comm] using (net.patch i).petal_left
30   · exact (net.patch i).petal_right
31   · exact (net.patch i).hinge_length
32 
33 theorem petalApexAngle_pos (i : Fin 4) : 0 < net.petalApexAngle i := by
34   rw [net.petalApexAngle_eq]
35   exact graph.fanAngle_pos _ _
36 
37 theorem petalApexAngle_lt_pi (i : Fin 4) : net.petalApexAngle i < π := by
38   rw [net.petalApexAngle_eq]
39   exact graph.fanAngle_lt_pi _ _
40 
41 theorem sum_petalApexAngle : (∑ i : Fin 4, net.petalApexAngle i) = 2 * π - graph.curvature source := by
42   simp only [net.petalApexAngle_eq]
43   have rotated : (∑ i : Fin 4, graph.fanAngle source (slit + i)) = ∑ i : Fin 4, graph.fanAngle source i := by
44     fin_cases slit <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> ring
45   rw [rotated, graph.sum_fanAngle]
46   unfold curvature
47   ring
48 
49 theorem widened_angle_sum (i : Fin 2) : net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i =
50     π - net.petalApexAngle i.castSucc.succ +
51       graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.castSucc) + 1)) +
52       graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1)) := by
53   have total := angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).apex
54     (ne₁₂_of_not_collinear (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).petal_noncollinear).symm
55   rw [angle_comm (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).right (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).apex,
56     angle_comm (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).apex (net.patch i.castSucc.succ).left] at total
57   unfold widenedLeft widenedRight petalApexAngle
58   linarith
59 
60 /-- A high-curvature source bounds each outer apex angle by the widened middle angle. -/
61 theorem opposite_apex_bounds_of_high_source (i : Fin 2) (high : π ≤ graph.curvature source) :
62     net.petalApexAngle i.castSucc.castSucc < net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i ∧
63       net.petalApexAngle i.succ.succ < net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i := by
64   have total := net.sum_petalApexAngle
65   rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at total
66   have positive := net.petalApexAngle_pos
67   have left_gap := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.castSucc) + 1))
68   have right_gap := graph.curvature_pos small_faces (fanNeighbor source ((slit + i.castSucc.succ) + 1))
69   rw [net.widened_angle_sum]
70   fin_cases i
71   · change net.petalApexAngle 0 < π - net.petalApexAngle 1 + _ + _ ∧
72       net.petalApexAngle 2 < π - net.petalApexAngle 1 + _ + _
73     constructor <;> linarith [positive 0, positive 2, positive 3]
74   · change net.petalApexAngle 1 < π - net.petalApexAngle 2 + _ + _ ∧
75       net.petalApexAngle 3 < π - net.petalApexAngle 2 + _ + _
76     constructor <;> linarith [positive 0, positive 1, positive 3]
77 
78 /-- If all six curvatures are at most pi, Gauss--Bonnet supplies the same cone angle bounds. -/
79 theorem opposite_apex_bounds_of_all_low (i : Fin 2) (low : ∀ v, graph.curvature v ≤ π) :
80     net.petalApexAngle i.castSucc.castSucc < net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i ∧
81       net.petalApexAngle i.succ.succ < net.widenedLeft i + net.widenedRight i := by
82   have total := net.sum_petalApexAngle
83   rw [Fin.sum_univ_four] at total
84   have positive := net.petalApexAngle_pos
85   have curvature_total := graph.curvature_poles_equator source
86   have rotated : (∑ j : Fin 4, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source (slit + j))) =
87       ∑ j : Fin 4, graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source j) := by
88     fin_cases slit <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_four] <;> ring
89   rw [← rotated, Fin.sum_univ_four] at curvature_total
90   rw [net.widened_angle_sum]
91   fin_cases i
92   · change net.petalApexAngle 0 < π - net.petalApexAngle 1 +
93         graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 0) + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 1) + 1)) ∧
94       net.petalApexAngle 2 < π - net.petalApexAngle 1 +
95         graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 0) + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 1) + 1))
96     simp only [add_assoc, add_zero, show (1 : Fin 4) + 1 = 2 by decide] at *
97     constructor <;> linarith [positive 0, positive 2, positive 3,
98       low (opposite source), low (fanNeighbor source slit), low (fanNeighbor source (slit + 3))]
99   · change net.petalApexAngle 1 < π - net.petalApexAngle 2 +
100         graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 1) + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 2) + 1)) ∧
101       net.petalApexAngle 3 < π - net.petalApexAngle 2 +
102         graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 1) + 1)) + graph.curvature (fanNeighbor source ((slit + 2) + 1))
103     simp only [add_assoc, add_zero, show (1 : Fin 4) + 1 = 2 by decide,
104       show (2 : Fin 4) + 1 = 3 by decide] at *
105     constructor <;> linarith [positive 0, positive 1, positive 3,
106       low (opposite source), low (fanNeighbor source slit), low (fanNeighbor source (slit + 1))]
107 
108 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
